title: Fix rejected drain PR #88 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-19)
description:
Drain PR #88 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-19`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-19 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-19`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-19` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- regex pattern fails to match existing sections with content
- incorrect handling of section content replacement
- does not properly escape regex special characters in replacement
- test coverage incomplete for edge cases
